modifications.summary: Reduced frontmatter to Codex-supported name and description fields; replaced host-specific wording with Codex skill-root and cross-platform Python guidance.
Render the next command with the active Python executable and an absolute script path on Windows and POSIX.
Replaced Claude-specific browser wording with Codex-native and already-installed browser options.
Made command examples interpreter- and shell-neutral for Windows and macOS.
Replaced a non-vendored local-memory reference with the bundled objectness implementation.
Moved bundled index caches outside installed plugin sources and added explicit approved cache-root routing.
Added native Windows and macOS common-image conversion plus a confirmed, hash-locked ImageMagick fallback without shell execution.
Bounded and validated remote metadata and image retrieval, blocked private or local targets and unsafe output names, and constrained redirects.
Replaced PATH executable discovery with a confirmed absolute-path, SHA-256, version, license, publisher, and plan-digest manifest plus a bounded process timeout.
Added Codex plugin metadata and agents/openai.yaml without changing the staged quality gates.
Normalized cross-platform line endings and removed trailing whitespace for deterministic archives without semantic changes.
